Tree, but got stranded and was
swallowed by Luxuria, mo...

rows.label: qst500207_msg0003

Teos Aure is an amazing place, mo.
Foorara is quietly impressed, mo.

rows.label: qst500207_msg0004
rows.name:
Teos Aure is an amazing place, mo.
Foorara is quietly impressed, mo.

rows.label: qst500207_msg0005
rows.name:
It's freezing outside the capital,
but the moment you go inside it's
warm and cozy, mo.

rows.label: qst500207_msg0006
rows.name:
Even the walls of these ruins feel
slightly warm when I touch them, mo...

rows.label: qst500207_msg0007
rows.name:
Amazing technology, mo. I'd like to
use it when Fortis Trade Guild goes
somewhere cold, mo...

rows.label: qst500207_msg0008
rows.name:
The Fortis Trade Guild travel guide
says to buy any souvenir you like
without hesitating, mo.

rows.label: qst500207_msg0009
rows.name:
So I'll take one of these ruin pillars
home as a souvenir, mo.

rows.label: qst500207_msg0011
rows.name:
Foorara just heard about a place tied
to Hero Adel, mo. Foorara will go
there next, mo.

rows.label: qst500207_msg0012
rows.name:
If fate brings us together again,
take care of me, mo.
